Pool availability

We have a variety of aquatic facilities available for casual lap swimming, family play and hydrotherapy. Check out the availability below!

We endeavor to keep the availability as accurate as possible, however, please note that pool availability is subject to change. Any changes to pool availability (outside of lap swimming) will be communicated via our Notifications webpage.

Please note that the pool areas will be cleared ten minutes prior to their closure, to ensure patrons have sufficient time to change before the space is no longer supervised.
